title: Tech Stack
subtitle: Tools, languages, and architectures used to build robust software.

items.dotnet: High-performance RESTful APIs, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and LINQ.
items.nodejs: Asynchronous web services, modular middlewares, routing, and scalable microservices.
items.python: AI agent development, XML-RPC automation, and LLM integrations.
items.ef: ORM for .NET with Code-First approach, automated migrations, and optimized queries.
items.jwt: Secure role-based access control (RBAC), encrypted tokens, and route protection.
items.react: Interactive Single Page Applications, Custom Hooks, component architecture, and state.
items.tailwind: Mobile-first responsive design, fluid micro-animations, and modern design systems.
items.javascript: Modern JavaScript and TypeScript: promises, async/await, DOM manipulation and typed, modular code.
items.htmlcss: Accessible semantic structures, Grid, Flexbox, CSS variables, and accelerated animations.
items.postgres: Robust relational modeling, foreign keys, high-performance indexes, and ACID transactions.
items.sqlserver: Advanced T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and native .NET ecosystem integration.
items.mysql: Efficient schema design, normalization, and connection with Node.js architectures.
items.prisma: Strict typing with declarative schemas, safe migrations, and TypeScript/Node queries.
items.git: Distributed version control, branches, pull requests, and clean repository maintenance.
items.cleanarch: Decoupled design patterns, layer separation (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API).
items.docker: Lightweight virtualization for development environments and reproducible deployments on VPS.
items.odoo: Odoo ERP integrations via XML-RPC and JSON-RPC: automated leads and processes.
items.ollama: Local AI with Ollama applied to process automation.
items.agile: Scrum and Kanban: short iterations, boards and continuous delivery.
items.network: Routing, switching and LAN/WAN connectivity; server and hardware support.
